description_en: Creates a digital short message template
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi create-digital-sms-template --template-name '0000模板' --remark '000业务需要' --template-contents FileSuffix=txt FileContents=字符 FileName=file-1 FileSize=1840901 --sign-name '签名' --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDigitalSmsTemplate

parameters.help_en: The template name. The name cannot exceed 20 characters
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称,不要超过20字符
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the template application. Describe your business scenarios in the description
parameters.help_zh: 短信模板申请说明。请在申请说明中描述您的业务使用场景
parameters.name: remark

fields.help_en: The Base64-encoded string of the file binary array. Specify UTF-8 as the encoding format during the conversion
fields.help_zh: 文件二进制数组转base64，转的时候指定编码格式为UTF-8
fields.name: file_contents

fields.help_en: The file name extension. Text content is converted to txt. Images support gif, jpg, and png formats. Audio supports mp3 format. Video supports mp4 format. Only one video file can be uploaded
fields.help_zh: 文件后缀名，文字内容转成txt，图片支持gif、jpg、png格式，音频支持mp3格式，视频支持mp4格式，目前只支持上传一个视频文件
fields.name: file_suffix

fields.help_en: The file name without the extension
fields.help_zh: 文件名称，不要带扩展名
fields.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: The array of short message template content
parameters.name: template_contents
